biotools.summary: CodonMoE is a lightweight adapter that transforms DNA language models into highly effective RNA analyzers. It significantly improves performance on codon-dependent RNA tasks (e.g., stability, expression) without requiring specialized RNA pretraining, unifying genomic modeling.
